title: Tool Progression
body:
**Tool Progression⚒️**

Tool Progression is a light overhaul to the early game of Minecraft, removing the ability to obtain wood and stone tools in survival as well as the ability to mine logs with your hands. Instead, you start with Flint tools (replacing wood tools).

**The Basics🦴**

  1. Simple to obtain: Get Sticks from leaves and Flint from gravel.

  2. Flint Pickaxe: Does everything wood tools can, but it is also required to mine Copper.

  3. Copper Pickaxe: Acts as the bridge to the next tier, allowing you to mine Iron.

The progression now flows like this: Flint > Copper > Iron > Diamond > Netherite

**Current Status🧪**

Tool Progression is currently in Beta. There may be issues since this is my first mod. Also, expect limited mod compatibility. You can report issues or recommend improvements in the Discord! 💬



I have plans on expanding on this systerm and other survival overhauls at some point, you can keep up with this project and others in the discord aswell.
